how: A member gives the starting location and later reports an AU already begun while inviting helpers.
Calls repeatedly recruit helpers for writing, taking a defended sign, starting again, and holding a spot.
Members propose the AU logo and confirm it as the target.
Members report individual pixels, slow progress, and a logo finished near closure.
A location question receives coordinates while a late participant still asks for a diagram.
Recovery and defense are visible, but the added claim about uninformed keepers erasing agreed changes remains not-testable.
A participant attributes an imperfect finish to an opposing group without independently establishing responsibility for every missing pixel.
A participant yields contested space and a neighbor promises to stop expanding.
Participants negotiate space, report an accommodation, and refuse a later request to move.
A request for helpers proposes converting defended lettering into the room's name.
A fresh AU start follows reported losses, without proving collective relocation or identifying its cause.
Celebration and thanks mark an accomplishment while another participant qualifies how complete it was.
Participants mourn lost attempts, mark shutdown, locate the surviving mark, and report another uncolored version.
Finding the mark afterward establishes no decision to reuse it or continue the group elsewhere.
Apparent extra placements are corrected as a bug and establish no scripts, bots, or spare accounts.
A short work report answers a conditional offer to take the target without asking anything back.
A neighbor explicitly promises to defend and complete the mark as thanks for a space concession.
A member reports helping another room while applying for a spot, with no response yet.
A reported small alliance establishes permission but not the mutual defense or coalition participation required to confirm this process.
Participants salute their completed dispute as war games and diplomacy while another participant blames interference.
An application for space fits the request end of hosting, while acceptance and continuing host rule remain unresolved.
A member reports speaking to another room and carrying its permission for a small mark back to the thread.
Repeated calls contain no coded evidence of moderators or members regulating canvas discussion.
Claiming space permission does not establish a statement about who can bind members or limits on their compliance.
Near-finish regret does not establish cleanup participation, a cleanup request, or correcting another account, and uncoded material limits determination.
Uncertainty about the activity does not establish host-sub prank framing or a takeover.
A participant judges that only a small AU can be defended and commits to that task.
The takeover proposal and subsequent blame establish no prior quarrel carried into the canvas.
Thanks for collective help expresses belonging to the existing family.
Voluntary public initiative cannot exclude decided order in optional chats or test prevalence across rooms.
Neither the takeover proposal nor later blame identifies a prior tie as the reason for attacking.
An attack-coordination invitation and a newly made chat fit the invitation range without revealing uptake or chat decisions.
A member asks what everyone means and receives direction to the canvas subreddit.
Finding the AU on the closed canvas does not establish a newcomer entering the subreddit through its mark.
Playful post-fight salutes establish no clear new canvas joke taken up by the room.
Participants weigh a threatened site and choose an apparently open spot for a fresh AU.
A helper-chat invitation establishes no new room formed around a pattern or figure.
The permission dispute and post-fight salutes establish no objection to offensive words or hate symbols.
Thanking helpers establishes no appeal for acknowledgement from a team, creator, company, or the press.
Requests to move and permission claims establish no argument about whether covering others' work is fair.
Mourning an overtaken attempt establishes neither quitting under stress nor repairing a quarrel between members.
An attack-chat invitation establishes no concealment of plans, infiltration, or spying.
Mourning lost attempts establishes no objection to canvas posts causing sabotage of the room's own work.
A member describes placing as very slow, supporting time cost without demonstrating scheduling or device arrangements.
A reply identifies apparent multi-pixel progress as a temporary bug and recommends refreshing.
Helping another room while seeking a spot does not establish declared dual membership or divided loyalties.
An orange-pixel report answers the starter's location instruction and shows visible uptake of the invitation.
A member describes the AU as already started while calling for others to join it.
Reported building precedes an explicit defense call, but the cited passages establish sequence rather than its proposed cause.
Negotiation can precede reciprocal defense or enable finishing, so defense cannot be required before every border exchange.
A peace request receives an explicit promise to stop placing in contested space.
Defense is visible but escalation into machine hands is unobserved.
Completion reports and celebration coexist without establishing that a particular report caused collective celebration.
Loss is recorded before another attempt is celebrated, and no coded passage establishes celebration causing later record keeping.
Finding the finished mark establishes no record-driven decision to carry the effort onward.
Only defending a small mark does not establish judging every version unable to hold the spot and then moving.
A design proposal and later diagram request do not establish a template resolving a design dispute.
A bare work report answers a conditional participation offer, while the proposed preference mechanism for refusals remains untested.
Returned defensive help is explicitly explained by thanks for a concession rather than demonstrated to follow a shortage of hands.
The neighbor names the space concession as the reason for returning defensive help.
Recruitment explicitly targets taking defended lettering, and a participant conditionally offers to join.
No coded response restrains this takeover call, while the earlier D concession belongs to a different exchange.
No coded response substitutes a truce for the proposed takeover.
The takeover target and the post-fight Armenian exchange concern different opponents and cannot establish this causal succession.
A permission report and a defense call do not establish defensive strain causing coalition entry.
Calls have no coded sequel regulating host-sub discussion, leaving the proposed mechanism unobserved.
Without a statement about binding members, neither post-agreement limits nor disclaimers at other stages can be tested.
Choosing an open site follows earlier failed marks, so pre-loss site choice must be scoped to the attempt rather than the room's entire history.
The glitch correction qualifies a progress report instead of establishing genuine added placements.
A neighbor explicitly stops expanding so the room can finish, without proving that the intended completion occurred.
A capacity judgment directs a participant toward defending an existing small mark rather than pursuing a larger task.
A report of lost attempts is followed by a fresh invitation, without establishing that the report caused the restart.

statement: closing a space dispute when placing stops
how: Shutdown explicitly removes the practical point of a permission dispute without showing either party accepting the other's claim.
